name: sii-4b-lora-train
description: SII-Decision-4B LoRA reproduction: official config (4 GPUs, micro 4, lr 5e-5), local base Qwen3.5-4B and local data/sii-4b; stops at released checkpoint step 276.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
V=$R/.venv-sii
mkdir -p $R/logs/qz $R/runs/qz
cd $R
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

export PYTHONPATH=$R/innerjev
export RUN_ID=${RUN_ID:-v1}
OUT=$R/runs/qz/sii_4b_lora/$RUN_ID
"$V/bin/python" -I $R/harness/sii_gpu_eval.py --check-model --model $R/models/Qwen3.5-4B || { echo "base model incomplete"; exit 3; }
mkdir -p "$OUT"
"$V/bin/torchrun" --standalone --nnodes 1 --nproc_per_node 4 -m sii_decision.train \
  --config $R/innerjev/configs/4B/lora.json \
  --base-model $R/models/Qwen3.5-4B \
  --data-dir $R/data/sii-4b \
  --output "$OUT" > $R/logs/qz/sii_4b_lora_train.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
